sources.name: Legal status of ozone therapy - Spanish Association of Medical Professionals in Ozone Therapy (AEPROMO)

_: Regularized for dentistry in 2015, medicine in 2018, and veterinary care in 2020. On 7 August 2023, the Brazilian government legalized ozone therapy as a complementary therapy, ignoring a request for veto due to lack of scientific evidence made in an open letter from the Brazi…
Legal in private centers in 15 of the 17 Spanish autonomous communities, as well as in roughly 23 Spanish hospitals.

Greece was the first country to regularize ozone therapy, doing so on 1991 for vascular surgery and broadening the scope in 2014 to include all specialties and diseases, both in the public and private sectors.
